sections.text:
This document outlines the equipment inspection I1, to be performed 
 every 8000 equivalent operating hours EOH 8000 as indicated in the title block

The gas turbine uses air as working fluid which is drown in and compressed by 
 the compressor, fuel is added and burnt in the combustion chamber to heat the 
 air to turbine inlet temperature, the hot gases is expanded in the turbine.

The exhaust gases leaves the turbine through the exhaust diffuser for being 
 discharged into the stack or to the heat recovery steam generator in the case 
 of combined cycle power plant, the useful output is available at the 
 compressor end coupling to drive the generator.

The first draft initiated by eng. 
Gamal EL-Sayed Xaater, 
tested by eng. Omar EL-Shenety، تمت مراجعته بواسطة المهندس. 
Samir Abdel Gilel: EDEPC inspection and quality control general 
director & MPIS coordinator, accepted by eng. Mohammed Anan general director, 
and approved by eng. Mohmed El-Sarrag: head sector of Damietta CCPS.
